name: HubSpot
description: Monitor HubSpot user access and contact owners for CRM compliance and access management

config.setupInstructions:
Step 1 — Create a HubSpot Private App
1. In HubSpot, go to Settings > Integrations > Private Apps (https://app.hubspot.com/private-apps)
2. Click Create a private app
3. Name it (e.g. "Comp AI")
4. Under Scopes, add:
   - account-info.security.read   (account info check)
   - settings.users.read           (employee access check)
   - crm.objects.owners.read       (contact information check)
5. Click Create app and copy the access token

Token format: starts with "pat-" followed by your data-center region (e.g. pat-na1-..., pat-eu1-..., pat-na2-...)

Step 2 — Paste the access token below

Note: HubSpot updates scopes on the existing token when you change them — no need to regenerate the token after adding scopes (as of 2024 docs).
